name: rc3-settings-0.0.3

schema.title: rc3 settings
schema.description: RC settings stored in the users RC_HOME directory

$schema.description: The JSON schema to use for validation

save_responses.description: Whether to save .response files in the same dir as the .request file

ca_bundle.description: Path to Python-like CA truststore file

collections.description: The list of collections (each collection should be an absolute path to the collection root directory)

description:
Hi team,

The current RC3 configuration follows the schema available at https://json.schemastore.org/rc3-settings-0.0.3.json. All response files are being saved alongside their corresponding request files, and the request timeout is set to 30 seconds. JSON output is formatted with an indentation width of 2 using spaces, and the system is configured to send no‑cache headers, follow redirects, and verify SSL certificates. Certificate verification uses the bundle located at `/etc/ssl/certs/ca-bundle.crt`.

At the moment the active collection is **default**, stored in `/home/user/.rc3/collections/default`. In addition, we have an archive collection named **archive** located at `/home/user/.rc3/collections/archive`.
